phases.goal: Pick up the blue bell without pressing or dragging the scale.
phases.name: grasp_blue_bell

phases.goal: Carry the held bell above the electronicscale.
phases.name: transport_over_scale
phases.verify: Bell is controlled above the scale support area.

phases.goal: Lower and release the bell onto the scale.
phases.name: release_on_scale
phases.verify: Bell rests on the scale after release.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Bell remains over the scale during lower.
Release leaves the bell supported on the scale.

task_language: Pick the smooth blue bell and carefully move it to the electronicscale with silver buttons
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=specified); 4:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 5:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 6:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 7:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 8:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 9:release(arm=left). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid moving toward the scale with an empty gripper; verify the blue bell lifts, stays over the scale, and remains supported after release.
